Let me check the history contents (which may reference a file the user already tried to load) and scan for any hidden files or other mount points I might have missed.

```python
import os, sqlite3, glob

# --- history.sqlite contents (reveals any file the user referenced) ---
hp = "abb-tablegpt-5utytjj_/profile/history.sqlite"
con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{hp}?mode=ro", uri=True)
cur = con.cursor()
print("=== sessions ===")
for row in cur.execute("SELECT * FROM sessions"):
    print(" ", row)
print("\n=== history (last commands) ===")
cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description] if cur.description else None
for row in cur.execute("SELECT * FROM history"):
    print(" ", row)
con.close()

# --- Hunt for ANY hidden files / other dirs at top level, incl. dotfiles ---
print("\n=== All entries in CWD (including hidden) ===")
for e in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    full = os.path.join(".", e)
    print(f"  {'DIR ' if os.path.isdir(full) else 'FILE'} {e}")

# --- Other likely mount points ---
print("\n=== Mount / upload locations ===")
for cand in ["/mnt", "/data", "/workspace", "/home", "/root", "/var/data", "/srv"]:
    print(f"  {cand}: {'exists -> ' + str(sorted(os.listdir(cand))[:20]) if os.path.isdir(cand) else 'MISSING'}")

# --- Any xlsx anywhere on the filesystem (bounded search) ---
print("\n=== Filesystem-wide search for spreadsheets (bounded) ===")
import fnmatch
found = []
roots = ["/mnt", "/data", "/workspace", "/home", "/root", "/tmp", "/content", "/opt", "/srv", "/var"]
for r in roots:
    if os.path.isdir(r):
        for dirpath, dirs, files in os.walk(r):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".cache", "__pycache__", "site-packages", "node_modules", "proc", "sys")]
            for f in files:
                if f.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xls", ".xlsm", ".csv", ".tsv", ".ods")):
                    found.append(os.path.join(dirpath, f))
if found:
    for f in found:
        print("  FOUND:", f, os.path.getsize(f), "B")
else:
    print("  (no spreadsheet files found anywhere in the scanned roots)")
```
